
```{r}
####use SCTransform for normalization
library(future)

plan(sequential)  # SUPER important on Mac to avoid fork crashes

options(future.globals.maxSize = 200 * 1024^3)  # 200 GB cap if you set R_MAX_VSIZE

SCT_merged <- SCTransform(
  SCT_merged,
  assay = "RNA",
  method = "glmGamPoi",       # faster + less RAM
  conserve.memory = TRUE,     # key for big objects
  verbose = TRUE,
  variable.features.n = 3000,  # reduce if still huge
  vst.flavor = "v2"  
)

```



```{r}
SCT_merged <- RunPCA(SCT_merged)
```


```{r}
obj_impac<- RunHarmony(
```

```{r}
# Map seurat_clusters -> annotated cell types
obj_impac$celltype <- recode(
  as.character(obj_impac$seurat_clusters),

  `0`  = "Neutrophils",
  `1`  = "Naive CD4 T cells",
  `2`  = "Plasma cells",
  `3`  = "Memory B cells",
  `4`  = "CD16 Monocytes",
  `5`  = "gd T cells",
  `6`  = "NK cells",
  `7`  = "CD14 Monocytes",
  `8`  = "Naive CD8 T cells",
  `9`  = "Neutrophils",
  `10` = "Th2 cells",
  `11` = "Plasma cells",
  `12` = "Plasmablasts",
  `13` = "CD16 Monocytes",
  `14` = "Erythrocytes",
  `15` = "Plasma cells",
  `16` = "Tregs",
  `17` = "HSC",
  `18` = "Platelets",
  `19` = "CD14 Monocytes",
  `20` = "DC",
  `21` = "Naive B cells",
  `22` = "pDC",
  `23` = "Plasma cells",
  `24` = "Plasma cells",
  `25` = "Plasma cells",

  .default = as.character(obj_impac$seurat_clusters)  # keep any others unchanged
)

# Use the annotated labels as identities
Idents(obj_impac) <- "celltype"
```


```{r}
DimPlot(obj_impac, group.by = "celltype", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE)

```
```{r}

#### extract the Tcells
tcell_obj <- subset(obj_impac, subset = celltype == c("Th2 cells","Naive CD4 T cells", "Tregs","Naive CD8 T cells","gd T cells"))

DefaultAssay(tcell_obj) <- "RNA"
 
# 2. Normalize / scale if needed
tcell_obj <- NormalizeData(tcell_obj)
tcell_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(tcell_obj)
tcell_obj <- ScaleData(tcell_obj)

 
# 3. Run PCA
tcell_obj <- RunPCA(tcell_obj)
ElbowPlot(tcell_obj, ndims = 40)

 
# 4. Find neighbors and clusters
tcell_obj <- FindNeighbors(tcell_obj, dims = 1:20)


# 5. Run UMAP for visualization
tcell_obj <- RunUMAP(tcell_obj, dims = 1:20)


# 6. 
tcell_obj <- FindClusters(tcell_obj, resolution = 0.5)

```

```{r}
  reference = reference,
  refdata = list(
    celltype.l1 = "celltype.l1",
    celltype.l2 = "celltype.l2",
    predicted_ADT = "ADT"

  reference.reduction = "spca", 
  reduction.model = "wnn.umap"
)
```
